WITH combo_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_reference,
    o.orderflow AS order_status,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    order_status,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS share
  FROM combo_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    order_status,
    record_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS above_status_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_reference,
  order_status,
  record_count,
  share,
  above_status_average
FROM scored
ORDER BY above_status_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
